pageTitle: Linette - Plan to save the world
description:
Pain is passed down from generation to generation. We didn't choose this pain.
I have a plan to break the cycle of pain.
Break it to be free.

idea.title: We have a lot of problems
idea.paragraph:
We inherited an internet that is restricted and censored, overflowing with politics, advertising, and other commercial activities. Sometimes you can't even watch a movie or anime in peace - something is always going wrong.

We inherited a life in which some groups of people are allowed to do whatever they want their whole lives and live peacefully, with all the necessary resources, while others can't afford housing and are forced to choose between ways of life they never liked.

We inherited an economy in which citizens of some countries live several times better than in others - they have different technologies and social order. Some people never have the opportunity to leave their country.

People, mired in the abundance of their own problems, are afraid to focus on the public good, despite the fact that their own problems could be solved precisely by universal consolidation. Humanity could agree not to wage wars and distribute resources evenly - investing in science, not in self-destruction. Our species' life could be based on faith in goodness and progress, not fear and war.

We already have enough technology to solve almost all social problems, but we lack organization and the individual's faith in rationality. People are afraid to be themselves, because their lives are constantly under the onslaught of a terrible past, unjustly and unintentionally handed down to them.

idea.title: How to solve everything
idea.paragraph:
If we fully automate electricity production, the most important resource for any other automation will become available in any country.

If food is grown on automated farms, we will increase the efficiency of production and space utilization. Food will become unlimited and accessible in all regions of the planet, regardless of climate – everyone will finally have food and clean water.

If robots extract and process minerals, people will have more opportunities to engage in science and creativity. All technical production will be automated, and technologies will begin to fully operate for themselves.

In this way, we can build a world in which human capabilities grow every day and in which you can do what you truly want, because everyone has enough resources to live. Everyone will be freed from the need to survive, and the world will switch to creative mode. This means everyone will have time to help each other and help society. We will finally solve all the problems on Earth and begin to conquer new planets.

idea.title: This project
idea.paragraph:
I want to build the life support system described. Some resource generators must help create others. This is exponential growth, and it must have a beginning.

I've figured out how to sow and nurture the seed of common sense - how to implement this project, even if there are absolutely no initial resources.

Everything is according to plan.

saving.title:
1: Creating a VPN platform.
Accumulation
saving.paragraph: To create something, you need start-up capital. This is where it's generated. I'm creating a service where developers can publish their VPN connections, and users can connect to them and get free internet. The platform takes a percentage of paid connections, generating capital for future developments.

generation.title:
2: Construction of eco-stations.
Generation
generation.paragraph: The system begins to operate for its own benefit. Accumulated funds are used to build eco-power plants, ensuring the system's initial economic independence. These funds are then used to benefit the VPN service, making paid connections free for everyone (while the developers continue to receive income).

scaling.title:
3: Helping your projects.
Scaling
scaling.paragraph: Automation of energy, agricultural food, raw material extraction and processing, and subsequent economic sectors, following Colin Clark's model. Subsequently, emerging resource generators should work to create and maintain new generators, potentially leading to exponential growth in automation. Money should work to eliminate the need for it.

result.title: The result of all actions
result.paragraph:
Ultimately, we should achieve a world in which people don't have to pay for basic needs like housing, food, technology, and so on. Capitalism can still be practiced, but the economy will be intelligently configured so that all the fundamental social problems are resolved, and people have more opportunities for creativity and a free life. This isn't a resource-based economy, but resource-based capitalism.

This won't necessarily rid our species of the problems of human vice, but it can at least free us to some extent from predetermined injustice. A truly free life will become the norm.

useApp.title: For now, just use my app
useApp.paragraph: The initial capital hasn't been accumulated yet. As long as you maintain an active VPN service, you'll enjoy a convenient way to surf the internet freely and also invest in the future creation of eco-stations. You can choose between free and paid connections, or become a developer and publish your connections for income.
